summary: OpenAI published a customer case study describing how Univé, a Dutch insurer, rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise and Workspace Agents across its workforce for claims, underwriting and other knowledge work.

categories.reason: An insurer describes AI agents entering claims and underwriting decision workflows, a clinical/underwriting-adjacent process.
categories.quote: A Workspace Agent can assemble the claim file, review veterinary invoices, check policy conditions, identify missing information, highlight anomalies, and prepare a traceable recommendation before the claims handler begins their assessment.

practices.reason: The case study describes a Workspace Agent pattern that pre-assembles context and queues before human review, but with no reproducible technical detail beyond the customer's own description.
practices.quote: Before an underwriter starts the day, a Workspace Agent reviews the incoming work queue, combines information from approved enterprise sources, identifies missing documentation, flags risk indicators, and highlights cases requiring priority attention.
